notes.title: v1.4 Dungeon Update
notes.content:
Update content:
1. Classic mode significantly updated: switched from theme to dungeon mode.
2. New game currency mechanism based on game score.
3. New talent ability, you can spend currency to unlock it permanently and make yourself more powerful.
4. Optimize the challenge mode and leaderboard.
5. Update the tutorial to make it easier for players to understand.
6. fix some language translation problems

notes.title: V1.2 Update
notes.content:
Specific updates.
1. New challenge mode and leaderboard. 
2. New "About Us" interface. 
3. Optimize the scoring details. 
4. Merge tutorials into the main game. 
5. Fix the block icons.

notes.title: Game experience optimization
notes.content:
Optimization content includes：
1. Optimize cover UI and add quit game button.
2. Add custom resolution function.
3. Improve the problem of missing or wrong translation.
4. Optimize the end game interface and add scoring.
